title: California Schedule CA (540) — California Adjustments — Residents — 2024
rationale: California does not conform to the federal qualified business income deduction under IRC §199A. The $36,000 QBI deduction taken on federal Form 1040 line 13 is added back as an addition on Schedule CA (540), Part I, Section B, line 8z, column C. All other federal amounts flow through column A with no adjustment unless additional facts are provided.
